text: the quota extension is done. repo is here https://github.com/CostaFot/agents-panel-extension

claude.summary: Agents Panel for Command Palette is a Windows 11 PowerToys Command Palette extension that shows usage and quota for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and opencode on the dock; it is published on the Microsoft Store. This closes the "AI agent usage & quota" gap from the 16 Aug CmdPal note.
